S1-07 sponsorship question with no timin.why: The spec does not make an untimed sponsorship question unknown; the candidate's Standard answer for 'require sponsorship (now or in the future)' is Yes (candidate-profile), so spons_future Yes is right.

L1-03 Springfield claim is true and may.why: 'Do you currently live in the local area where this internship is based?' names no place, so no rule recognises it as a relocation / on-site / commute / local-area question (spec section 3 applies only to those); unknown = asked, which is safe — the internship's location decides.

R1-03 current or most recent employer →: Superseded by Joey 2026-11-10 (JSA-288): "current or most recent employer" = the most recent employer (answers.recent_employer, rule recent_employer); only "current company / current employer" stays answers.employer.
